name: free-agents
description: 📡🦾 Run Claude Code on free inference, on two lanes: free cloud APIs (NVIDIA, Gemini and more) and local MLX models on Apple Silicon. Offload bounded sub-tasks from your paid session to a free model while your capable model keeps driving, or run whole free sessions with `csl` and `csl remote`. Includes a picker for lanes and models, role-based routing, free-tier key setup and a savings ledger.
